name: disclosure
summary: Reveals optional supporting content through native details and summary semantics.

agent.useWhen: Optional supporting detail can remain collapsed until a user requests it.
agent.avoidWhen: The content is required to complete the task or needs exclusive accordion behavior.

invariants: Summary is nonblank escaped text; body is provided only through the host-admitted body slot.
Default appearance is contained and default state is closed.
The native disclosure works without JavaScript; no ARIA state is recreated.
